questionBlocks.prompt: Tell me about your first setup experience

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Tell me about your first setup experience.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I got confused during account creation and had to restart twice.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: Once I found the checklist, things became much easier.

q-1.text: I got confused during account creation and had to restart twice.

questionBlocks.prompt: Walk me through your checkout experience

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I thought payment had gone through, but the button just kept spinning.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I refreshed the page and was scared I would get charged twice.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: Eventually I used a different card and it finally worked.

q-1.text: The checkout spinner made me think I might be charged twice.

questionBlocks.prompt: How did you discover the feature?

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I clicked around because the navigation labels were unclear.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I never thought about pricing or seats during that part.

q-1.text: I discovered it by clicking around unclear navigation.

questionBlocks.prompt: Describe the moment you got stuck

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: Every time I tried to continue, the form reset back to the first step.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: I repeated the same answers three times before giving up.

segments.speaker: participant
segments.text: That made me lose trust in the product immediately.

q-1.text: The form kept resetting to step one.
